name: khmer-ai-translator-pro
description: Khmer AI Translator Pro web frontend and Android build

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('WWW/index.html')) { console.error('ERROR: WWW/index.html not found. Keep the WWW folder in the project root.'); process.exit(1); } fs.rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true}); fs.cpSync('WWW','dist',{recursive:true}); console.log('SUCCESS: WWW copied to dist');"
